introduction: The codefix-on-engine spec rewrites codefix's pipeline to call internal/engine for branching, the ledger, commit-own, parking, the gate cache and verification; adds the run_checks model-facing tool; wires the prompt-document loader for a stable-prefix brief and per-phase templates; enables transcript pruning; writes check logs to a per-run scratch directory; and implements the targeted revert check — so that fix is a thin, readable sequence over the shared engine and meets the token-halving acceptance criteria.

glossary.engine: The internal/engine package (from spec 20_engine_core) providing Run, Ledger, GateCache, Park, SetupBranch, Push, OpenPullRequest, CommonPreflight, Background, and Invalidate.
glossary.gate cache: engine.GateCache — caches verification-command results keyed by tree hash so a landing gate that matches a prior run_checks call is a cache hit.
glossary.inline tests: Tests co-located in the same file as the implementation (e.g. Rust #[cfg(test)] modules), identified by lang.Profile.InlineTests.
glossary.ledger: engine.Ledger — tracks untracked files, classifies changes, and commits only the run's own work, replacing codefix/untracked.go.
glossary.profile: A lang.Profile from internal/lang (spec 19_language_profiles) describing a language's test conventions, targeted command, lint command, and inline-test flag.
glossary.prompt loader: internal/engine/prompt.Loader (from spec 21_prompt_documents) that renders Markdown templates with typed views.
glossary.run brief: A BriefView rendered once per run containing the report, repo map, project instructions, steering, language block, baseline verdicts, gate commands and --context; placed as the first user message for cache-prefix stability.
glossary.scratch directory: The per-run directory at .agent-fox/scratch/<session_id>/ for check logs and throwaway files, replacing the per-phase random directory.
glossary.targeted revert: A revert check that runs only the tests the change added or edited (from the ledger's classification and the profile's Targeted command) rather than the full suite.

requirements.title: Pipeline rewrite on the engine
requirements.rationale: Eliminating duplicated logic between codefix and codeimpl by delegating to the shared engine makes fix a thin, readable sequence and prevents the two pipelines from diverging.

criteria.action: call engine.NewRun, engine.CommonPreflight, engine.SetupBranch, engine.Ledger.Snapshot, engine.Ledger.Changes, engine.Ledger.Commit, engine.GateCache.Run, engine.Park, engine.Push, and engine.OpenPullRequest instead of the package-local implementations of the same operations

not contain the functions untrackedNow, commitOwn, commitOwnHooks, ownChange, parkWork, returnCheckout, background, invalidate, runChecks, branchPrefix, or openPullRequest (body-truncation variant), and the file codefix/untracked.go shall not exist
preserve the existing Run function signature, Options fields, Result fields (except additive ones), Failure type, exit codes, and LandMode semantics so that no caller must change

criteria.condition: the implement phase ends and the tree has changes
criteria.action: call engine.Ledger.Changes to classify the diff and engine.Ledger.Commit to commit only the run's own files, excluding pre-existing untracked files recorded by engine.Ledger.Snapshot

criteria.condition: the run creates a branch
criteria.action: call engine.SetupBranch with the classification-derived prefix, issue number, and title, and call engine.Invalidate after the checkout

criteria.condition: the run opens a pull request
criteria.action: call engine.OpenPullRequest, which truncates the body to the forge's limit, instead of sending an unbounded body

requirements.title: The run_checks model-facing tool
requirements.rationale: Giving the model a structured tool for running checks replaces ad-hoc shell invocations, feeds the gate cache, and prevents redundant full-suite runs.

criteria.action: accept a scope parameter (enum: "lint", "targeted", "all", default "all") and an optional tests parameter (array of strings), and be registered as a core.Tool in the implement phase alongside submit_implementation

criteria.condition: run_checks is called with scope "lint"
criteria.action: run the profile's Lint command and return the exit code, ok boolean, the last twenty lines of output, and the full-log path in the scratch directory

criteria.condition: run_checks is called with scope "targeted"
criteria.action: run the profile's Targeted command for the named tests (or the tests the ledger says the phase has written so far when tests is empty) and return the same result shape

criteria.condition: run_checks is called with scope "all"
criteria.action: run the full verification command, store the result in the GateCache keyed by tree hash, and return the same result shape

criteria.condition: run_checks is called with scope "all" for the third time in one phase
criteria.guard: two prior scope-all calls have already completed in the same phase
criteria.action: answer from the cache with a note that the budget of two all-scope calls per phase is exhausted, without running the command again

criteria.condition: the implement phase is active
criteria.action: refuse the suite's own command and the profile's untargeted Test command, naming run_checks as the alternative, while allowing targeted forms (with a file, test name, or package argument)

criteria.condition: run_checks is called with scope "targeted" on a profile with no Targeted command
criteria.action: fall back to scope "all" and include a note in the result explaining the fallback
criteria.contract: the result contains the note field explaining the fallback and the ok/exit_code from the full-suite run

criteria.condition: run_checks fails to compute the tree hash for the cache
criteria.action: run the command without caching and return the result
criteria.contract: the result is identical in shape to a cached run; no error is surfaced to the model

requirements.title: Prompt rendering from documents
requirements.rationale: Replacing Go string constants and fmt.Fprintf assembly with template rendering makes prompts auditable, versionable, and consistent with the prompt-document infrastructure from spec 21.

criteria.action: render all system prompts, phase messages, tool description overrides, guard refusals, and handler rejections through prompt.Loader.Render calls with the corresponding template names (fix/analyse.system.md, fix/analyse.md, fix/implement.system.md, fix/implement.md, tools/*.md, refusals/*.md, rejections/*.md)

not contain the Go constants analysisSystemPrompt or implementSystemPrompt (from codefix/phases.go) or the builder functions reportBlock, baselineBlock, criteriaBlock, contextBlock, analysisPrompt, implementPrompt, instructionsBlock, or projectInstructions (from codefix/prompts.go); the file codefix/prompts.go shall not exist
contain no model-facing string constant longer than one sentence (excluding template names and format-string keys)

criteria.condition: the run_checks tool description is rendered
criteria.action: render from tools/run_checks.md with the PhaseView carrying the suite commands, the targeted-test form, and the budget

requirements.title: Stable-prefix brief
requirements.rationale: Rendering the run brief once and placing it first enables provider-side prefix caching and reduces per-phase token cost.

criteria.action: build a BriefView once per run containing the language block, repository map, project instructions, steering, gate commands with baseline verdicts, --context value, and the report, and render it from brief/fix.md
use identical system-prompt text and tool schemas for every phase of the same kind within one run

place the brief as the first user message, followed by a cache breakpoint when AgentKit PRD 06 §3 is available, with phase-specific material (diagnosis, criteria, branch, date) in a second user message

criteria.condition: AgentKit's cache breakpoint (PRD 06 §3) is not yet available
criteria.action: still render the brief once and place it first in the user prompt, relying on the provider's prefix matching alone

requirements.title: Transcript pruning
requirements.rationale: Replacing stale tool results with stubs reduces context_tokens per phase, contributing to the token-halving goal.

criteria.condition: AgentKit PRD 06 §4 pruning transform is available
criteria.action: install the pruning transform so that tool results older than eight turns are replaced by a one-line stub naming the call and its size, and a read_file of a path and range already held unchanged returns a reference to that prior turn
keep summarisation as the backstop at 60% of the context window regardless of whether the pruning transform is installed

requirements.title: Per-run scratch directory with check logs
requirements.rationale: A single scratch directory per run (keyed by session id) pairs logs with the report and avoids per-phase churn; writing full check output to files and inlining only the tail reduces prompt tokens.

criteria.condition: a codefix run starts
criteria.action: create the scratch directory at .agent-fox/scratch/<session_id>/, write a .gitignore containing '*' in the scratch area, and use this single directory for all phases of the run

criteria.condition: the engine runs any external command (baseline, verification, revert check, or run_checks call)
criteria.action: write the command's full output to .agent-fox/scratch/<session_id>/checks/<label>.txt
include at most the last ten lines of check output inline in the prompt, plus a ref(path) reference to the full log file in the scratch directory

criteria.condition: the codefix run ends (on any path, including cancellation and error)
criteria.action: remove the scratch directory and, when .agent-fox/scratch and .agent-fox are then empty, remove them as well

criteria.condition: the scratch directory cannot be created
criteria.action: emit a warning and continue the run without check logs in the scratch directory
criteria.contract: the run completes with the same exit code it would have had; a warning is recorded via Run.Warn

requirements.title: Targeted revert check
requirements.rationale: Running only the tests the change added or edited (rather than the full suite) makes the revert check fast on large suites and correct for inline-test languages.

criteria.condition: the revert check runs and the profile has a Targeted command
criteria.action: run the profile's Targeted command for exactly the tests the change added or edited (from the ledger's classification), and set result.revert_check.mode to "targeted"

criteria.condition: the revert check runs on a profile with InlineTests
criteria.guard: the changed files contain inline tests identified by the profile's test convention
criteria.action: revert by declaration (line ranges from the file outline) rather than by file, leaving the inline tests in place, and set result.revert_check.declarations to the list of reverted declarations

criteria.condition: the revert check runs and the profile has no Targeted command
criteria.action: run the full suite (current behaviour) and set result.revert_check.mode to "suite"

hold the implementation in a commit object (via git stash create when the tree is dirty, or a wip: commit with git reset --soft to undo when clean) before anything is put back, so a crash or kill -9 during the check loses no work

criteria.condition: the revert check is cancelled (Ctrl-C)
criteria.action: restore the implementation from the commit object, call engine.Park, and exit with code 4 and category aborted

criteria.condition: a compile error occurs with the implementation removed
criteria.action: classify the failure using the profile (build failure vs test failure); set proves to true and reason to 'failure was not classified' only when the profile cannot distinguish the two

criteria.condition: the outline of a changed file cannot be parsed for declaration-level revert
criteria.action: fall back to file-level revert for that file
criteria.contract: the revert check completes with the file-level revert; no error is returned to the caller

requirements.title: Cancellation handling
requirements.rationale: Every cancellation path must leave no dirty tree, report aborted, and be resumable by re-running the same command.

criteria.condition: Ctrl-C is received during the implement phase
criteria.action: cancel the phase, call engine.Park to commit the work as wip:, return the checkout to the base branch, and exit with code 4 and category aborted

criteria.condition: Ctrl-C is received during the landing gate
criteria.action: set the gate result's Aborted flag to true, call engine.Park, and exit with code 4 and category aborted
for any cancelled run, leave no uncommitted changes on the work branch and produce a result that is resumable by re-running the same command

requirements.title: Additive envelope fields and conform.Scan integration
requirements.rationale: New result fields expose language detection, revert mode, cache hits, and pruning metrics without breaking existing callers; passing lang.Detection to conform.Scan enables polyglot structural checks.

criteria.action: include result.language with fields primary (string), detected ([]string), and verify.source (one of "makefile", "profile", "flag", "none"), populated from lang.Detection
include result.revert_check.mode ("targeted" or "suite") and result.revert_check.declarations (when the revert was by declaration)

criteria.condition: a gate check is answered from the cache
criteria.action: set timings[].cached to true on the corresponding timing entry

criteria.condition: the pruning transform is installed and removes tokens
criteria.action: set usage.phases[].pruned_tokens to the number of tokens the pruning transform removed
include prompt_templates (map of document name to SHA-256) in the full report
pass ScanInput.Lang set to the lang.Detection from the engine's Run when calling conform.Scan, so the structural checks use the profile's classifiers
not change any existing flag, exit code, event type, or required result field; the --schema golden files change only by the additive fields defined in this requirement

requirements.title: Documentation updates
requirements.rationale: The steering directives require that every user-facing or developer-facing surface change is reflected in the documentation in the same session.

criteria.action: document the aborted verdict in the verdict table, describe targeted revert mode in the revert check section, document run_checks under 'What the model may and may not do', and list the additive result fields
document the run brief and stable prefix, the pruning transform, the scratch logs, run_checks, and rewrite the 'Prompt templates' section for the engine's documents, views and helpers
document the prompts/ subdirectory under 'State directory' and the language profiles with what each detects
document internal/lang and internal/engine in the package layout section and add per-language baseline rows

execution_paths.title: Successful fix: engine pipeline from report to landed PR

steps.action: runs af fix with a bug report and --land=pr
calls engine.NewRun to build the Run value with lang.Detect, then engine.CommonPreflight for repository, clean tree, base branch, remote, and forge auth
resolves the verification command via lang.Detection.VerifyCommand and runs the baseline via engine.GateCache.Run
builds the BriefView once and renders the analysis system prompt and phase message from fix/analyse.system.md and fix/analyse.md via prompt.Loader
runs the analysis phase (read-only agent), receives the Analysis, and calls engine.SetupBranch to create the work branch
calls engine.Ledger.Snapshot to record untracked files, then runs the implement phase with the run_checks tool registered
calls run_checks with scope 'targeted' to verify its test, then scope 'all' to run the full gate; results are stored in the GateCache
calls engine.Ledger.Changes and engine.Ledger.Commit to classify and commit the change
calls engine.GateCache.Run for the landing gate (cache hit from the model's prior all-scope run_checks call)
runs the targeted revert check using the profile's Targeted command for the tests the change added, with the implementation held in a commit object
calls conform.Scan with ScanInput.Lang set, runs the review phase, then calls engine.Push and engine.OpenPullRequest
removes the per-run scratch directory and returns the result with stage 'landed'

execution_paths.title: Cancelled run during implement phase: park and abort

steps.action: runs af fix and presses Ctrl-C during the implement phase
cancels the implement phase, calls engine.Park to commit the work as wip: under a background context
returns the checkout to the base branch and exits with code 4, category aborted, and the result marked as resumable
runs af fix with a report
completes the implement phase, calls engine.Ledger.Commit, and runs the landing gate via engine.GateCache.Run
the gate verdict is VerdictRegressed; calls engine.Park to commit the work as wip:, returns the checkout to the base branch, and exits with category unverified

execution_paths.title: Targeted revert with inline tests on an InlineTests profile

steps.action: reaches the revert check step with a profile that has InlineTests set and a Targeted command
holds the implementation in a commit object via git stash create
reverts by declaration (line ranges from the outline) rather than by file, leaving inline tests in place
runs the profile's Targeted command for exactly the tests the change added or edited
restores the implementation from the commit object and returns the RevertResult with mode 'targeted' and the declarations list

execution_paths.title: run_checks budget exhaustion and cache hit

steps.action: calls run_checks with scope 'all' twice during the implement phase, both completing and storing results in the GateCache
calls run_checks with scope 'all' a third time
answers from the cache with a note that the budget of two all-scope calls per phase is exhausted, without running the command
after the implement phase, calls engine.GateCache.Run for the landing gate, which is a cache hit from the second all-scope call
